shared_elements: tall upright stone slab / pillar with carved surface
band or row of repeated motifs
animal or creature heads in relief
small anthropomorphic figure with visible limbs
rectangular framing edge along the slab
justification: Both are tall rectangular stone monuments whose carved faces are divided into stacked horizontal zones, each including a row of repeated small motifs and at least one creature head plus a small limbed figure. Beyond that generic scheme they diverge sharply: A is a sparse, shallow, outline-like relief with isolated animals on bare ground, while B is a dense, deeply undercut composition with a dominant central figure enclosed by continuous ornamental borders and panels of blocky sign-like units.
